verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs list a first-party capability for "Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web." Websets results can arrive asynchronously, with real-time webhook callbacks as items are added. That is a genuine recurring-job feature, but it is evidenced only by a one-line mention and is limited to searches rather than general workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of how schedules or cadences are configured (API or dashboard), scheduling of arbitrary workflows or agent runs beyond searches, run history and management controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
